User Submitted Content

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Safely embed user-provided content into an HTML template. Parameters ---------- user_input : str The raw string provided by the user. It may contain characters that need to be escaped (e.g., <, >, &, ", '). Returns ------- str The final HTML string with the user content properly escaped to prevent injection attacks such as cross‑site scripting (XSS). Notes ----- The function uses `html.escape` to neutralize special HTML characters.
